<thought>Using the high‑resolution ESI mass spectrum, the monoisotopic peak is at m/z 127.099714. Solving for a formula with C, H, O and one other element gives an exact match for C₇H₁₃NO (C7 H13 O1 N). This fits the observed M+1 (~8 %) and M+2 (~0.5 %) isotopic pattern. Therefore the molecular formula in the required format is C7H13O1N.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H13O1N</final_answer>
